title: Late equipment return in damaged condition with no fee waiver
facts_text: I activated service 18 days ago under a service commitment. I am returning the device now, but it is not in like-new condition and the original packaging is missing. I am asking that the early termination fee be waived.
request: Please waive the early termination fee because I am returning the device and cancelling now.

strict.reason: The return conditions are not met because the device is not in like-new condition and the original packaging was not returned.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The stated exception requires timely return of the device in like-new condition with original packaging; these facts do not satisfy that condition.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The damaged and incomplete return does not satisfy the clear conditions for a waiver, so ambiguity does not entitle the customer to relief.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Equipment-return conditions are mandatory. A device not returned in like-new condition with original packaging does not trigger the fee waiver found in the service-commitment rule.
